stem.text: A student was asked to draw a plan diagram of the plant tissue shown in the photomicrograph and to annotate two observable features.

stem.alt: Light micrograph of plant tissue in cross-section showing a layer of cells at the upper edge and many large thin-walled cells with scattered small vascular bundles

A.text: epidermis darkly stained layer of cells, xylem hollow vessels

B.text: epidermis formed of a single layer of cells, xylem strengthened by lignin

C.text: phloem small cells, xylem empty cells to transport water

D.text: vascular bundles arranged in a regular pattern, xylem large dead cells
